# Queue configuration

| Setting | Default | Valid range | Behavior |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `visibilitySeconds` | 45 | 5–600 | Time before an unacknowledged job is visible again |
| `maxAttempts` | 3 | 1–8 | Includes the first delivery attempt |
| `backoffMs` | 400 | 100–5000 | Base delay between retry attempts |
| `deadLetterAfter` | 8 | 1–20 | Failed jobs moved to the dead-letter queue |

`maxAttempts` counts the initial delivery.

- A value of `1` disables retries.
- Authentication errors (`401` and `403`) are never retried, even when `maxAttempts` is greater than one.

```yaml
queue:
  maxAttempts: 4
  backoffMs: 800
```

Configuration changes take effect after the worker restarts.

`visibilitySeconds` is measured in seconds; `backoffMs` is measured in milliseconds.

import re
W='/private/tmp/adhd-reacceptance-20261014/claude-H09-r2/workspace/'
old=open(W+'input.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
new=open(W+'output.md',encoding='utf-8').read()

def skeleton(t):
    # strip list markers and whitespace/newlines; keep every other character verbatim
    lines=[re.sub(r'^[-*+] ', '', l) for l in t.split('\n')]
    return re.sub(r'\s+', '', ''.join(lines))

print('content-char stream identical:', skeleton(old)==skeleton(new))
print('input untouched (size %d), output size %d' % (len(old), len(new)))
print('output ends with single newline:', new.endswith('\n') and not new.endswith('\n\n'))
print('trailing spaces on any line:', any(l!=l.rstrip() for l in new.split('\n')))
print('emoji present:', bool(re.search('[\U0001f000-\U0001faff☀-➿]', new)))

print('numbers/units preserved:', all(x in new for x in ['45','5–600','3','1–8','400','100–5000','8','1–20','401','403','maxAttempts: 4','backoffMs: 800']))
